# Dennis Petri

> Dennis Petri is a creative director and product designer based in The Hague, the Netherlands, with 20+ years in digital design. Speed is solved. Judgement isn't. He finds the product organisations' people actually need, decides what good looks like, and makes sure it ships. He works with organisations sitting on knowledge their people can't reach, and teams that want to be sure they're building the right thing. Most client relationships run 5+ years. Trained at the Willem de Kooning Academy in Rotterdam. Note: Dennis Petri the designer is not the political scientist Dennis P. Petri (petri.phd).

## What he does
Product design, creative direction and product strategy for apps and websites, plus interim design and product management. Fixed-price projects or a retainer. He no longer offers the Handoff €199 review or mentoring.

## Who it's for
Organisations sitting on knowledge their people can't reach, and teams that want to be sure they're building the right thing. Most client relationships run 5+ years.

## Current clients
Most client relationships run five years or longer.
- ESOMAR (2026-present): digital design and strategy, redesign of the ESOMAR Directory, the global index of research suppliers.
- Dutch Quality Group (2019-present): product design, concept and digital strategy for the consumer brands EYYE and Design on Stock. In practice DQG's external design, PM and online marketing department.
- Milvum (2018-present): product design for apps and software, from first idea to shipped product, plus interim PM. Work for ING, Pixelfit and Sportief Besteed Groep.
- Also: ATNi, Grote Kerk Breda, Merkregisseurs, Ministerie van Economische Zaken (via Backspace), Scale Up Experience, TOF Helmets, UWV Cliëntenraad.

## Past engagements
Earlier work includes: F19, Nationale Nederlanden, Innovattic, Sobolt, Vivat, Hello Public, and NeuralTeq.

## Selected work
- Rapport Wennink (rapportwennink.nl): launch website for the national strategy report on future prosperity, with Backspace and the Dutch Ministry of Economic Affairs.
- NeuralTeq (neuralteq.com): ongoing branding and website for a decentralised AI company in the Bittensor ecosystem.

## Past engagements
F19 (2018-2024), Innovattic (2018-2021), Sobolt (2019-2021), Vivat (2018-2020), Nationale Nederlanden (2017-2018), Goodmorrow (2015-2018), Jazz de Ville (2017-2018).

## Career
- 2018-present: Dennis Petri, independent product design and creative direction practice.
- 2021-present: founder and creative director of Handoff.
- 2008-2018: founder and creative director of Elastik.Concepts, design and concept studio in The Hague.
- 2009-2013: co-founder of Sparkle*, an online dating product. His first shipped product.
- 2005-2007: senior designer at TamTam (now part of Dept).
- Earlier: co-founder and creative director of 105, senior designer at BVH (Rotterdam), interactive graphic designer at Fabrique, multimedia graphic designer at Euro RSCG Bikker.
- 2021-2026: mentor on ADPList, 100+ sessions on product design and building with AI.
